scenarios.name: raster
scenarios.note: A raster node: the image fitted over its checkerboard, a marker stroke with the brush's outline under the pointer, a marquee's ants, a lasso and a crop while they are dragged, then the crop applied and the image fitted again. The view is centred at window (240, 168), at 1.98 window units per image pixel

steps.note: A marker stroke across the transparent half, from image (120, 30) to (180, 90)

expect.note: the brush's outline stays under the pointer

steps.note: A marquee over the stroke: its ants
A lasso while it is drawn: its outline follows the pointer
A crop while it is dragged: the rest shaded, its thirds
